articles.summary: Establishment Labs Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: ESTA), a global medical technology company dedicated to improving women’s health and wellness, principally in breast aesthetics and reconstruction, announced the presentation of new clinical and scientific data supporting Breast Tissue Preservation and its Minimally Invasive Platform. Establishment Labs also announced the product line extensions of both Mia ® and Preservé™ with new sizes and supporting tools. The announcements took place during the 11th World Symposium on Ergonomic Implants (WSEI), in Istanbul, Turkey. WSEI brought together over 1,000 plastic surgeons from 57 countries and featured 127 individual scientific presentations and educational sessions , highlighting advances in breast aesthetics, reconstruction, minimally invasive techniques, and the science of breast tissue preservation. Among the data presented at WSEI were findings from the recently published Breast Tissue Preservation Building Blocks Supplement in the Aesthetic
articles.title: Establishment Labs® Highlights New Breast Tissue Preservation Data and Announces Minimally Invasive Product Extensions at the 11th World Symposium on Ergonomic Implants
